game.title: The Darkness II
game.blurb: Supernatural first-person shooter from Digital Extremes and 2K, published by 2K Games, released 2012-02-07. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story

chapters.title: Powers and Combat

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4223). The only Steam store match is app 67370; its schema has an empty game name. 12 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden (descriptions blank); their names read like story chapter titles, so they sit in the main story chapter. The five "Kill <name>" achievements name characters but not which mode they belong to, so they have their own chapter instead of a guess. StrategyWiki has no page for "The Darkness II"; "The Darkness 2" was also tried and is missing too. thedarkness.fandom.com answers the API with about 19 linked pages (including "Missions in The Darkness II" and "Vendettas"); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
